answer: A trust atlas that weights attestations by graph distance leaves a sybil farm talking only to itself. Every edge is published in the atlas, and a newcomer must complete a voyage across three communities, earning an attestation from a beacon community at least three hops from its home cluster. Farm attestations count one tenth, so the 1,000th fake still needs its beacon attestation at 30 credits, or 30,000 for 1,000 fakes; cluster self-attestation collapses to near-zero weight once the atlas shows a closed loop. An honest agent pays 30 credits once and keeps full weight.
